clue.text: Shop has soft grain for next to nothing

parts.note: to shop someone is to inform on them, to give them away
p (piano) is the musical abbreviation for soft
rice is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: A store stocks cheap soft grain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shop' looks like a noun but is the verb, British slang for betraying someone to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: A bargain cost so low the goods are almost free is described with this idiom.

clue.text: Recited where the car that hit Edward went

parts.note: a car that hits something goes into it
Ned is a pet form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: A grim question of where a car went after hitting a man called Edward.
explanation.walkthrough: The car crashed into Ned, so the place it went is spelt out as two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Words spoken in a measured chanting voice have been delivered this way, a synonym for recited.

clue.text: In Kiev entertainment is constant

indicators.note: In tells us the letters sit inside the run of words Kiev entertainment

explanation.surface: Shows in the Ukrainian capital never change.
explanation.definitionFit: Something steady and unvarying is described as regular or level.

clue.text: Loss incurred by Washington theatre

parts.note: WA is the abbreviation for the US state of Washington
the stage stands for the theatre as a profession

explanation.surface: A deficit run up by a theatre in Washington.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste or loss through use or leakage is a synonym.

clue.text: Bore admitted defeat

explanation.definitionFit: Trees produced or bore fruit, and a beaten side gave in or surrendered: both senses of one verb.

clue.text: Cole — a king to copy

parts.note: R (rex) is the abbreviation for king
to ape is to imitate or copy

explanation.surface: A man named Cole and a monarch are told to imitate each other.
explanation.walkthrough: Cole looks like a surname, but it is a name for the oilseed plant colza.
explanation.definitionFit: Cole, or colza, is the brassica grown for oilseed under this other name.

clue.text: Note wild desire

parts.note: C is one of the musical notes
raving means wild or frenzied

explanation.surface: Take note of an untamed longing.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong longing or yearning is a synonym for desire.

clue.text: Feign indifference if the drama is out of print

parts.note: a play is a drama
a book out of print is hard to get

explanation.surface: Pretending not to care if a theatrical script can no longer be bought.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means pretending to lack interest so as to seem more desirable.

clue.text: Disorderly person I detain as a last resort

indicators.note: disorderly signals that the letters of person I detain are jumbled

explanation.surface: Police hold an unruly individual only when everything else has failed.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting out of hopelessness when nothing else works is doing something as a last resort.

clue.text: Post requiring erudition

explanation.definitionFit: Post is mail delivered, and a man of learning is said to be a man of this, meaning literary scholarship.

clue.text: To render an account is no longer simple

parts.note: ex means former, no longer so
plain means simple

explanation.surface: Giving a report is no longer straightforward.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a clear description or justification of something is a synonym.

clue.text: American pull

explanation.definitionFit: A Yankee is a slang term for someone from the US, and a sharp tug is also called this.

clue.text: Within 24 hours theologian will become a father

indicators.note: within says one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a day lasts 24 hours
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree

explanation.surface: A divinity scholar is about to have a baby.
explanation.definitionFit: A child's familiar word for a parent who is male, i.e. dad.

clue.text: Female pursued with fury and passion

indicators.note: pursued with says the first piece is chased and followed by the next

parts.note: ire means anger or fury

explanation.surface: An angry, ardent woman is chased.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardour or fervour is described as this, a synonym for passion.

clue.text: A continental drinking place is open

parts.note: un is French for a, the indefinite article on the continent
a bar is a place for drinking

explanation.surface: A European pub is open for business.
explanation.definitionFit: To unbolt a door is to open it; both are verbs.

clue.text: Essential to place teaspoon in medicine bottle

indicators.note: to place one thing in another puts one piece inside the bottle
this word is a container marker: it says one piece is placed inside the other, and the clue words of the pieces show which way round

parts.note: a vial is a small bottle for medicine
t is the cookery abbreviation for teaspoon

explanation.surface: Instructions for measuring a dose into a medicine bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indispensable or crucial is a synonym for essential.

clue.text: Not only after is it notedly slow

parts.note: not only ... but also is the same as saying and
the phrase not only after implies and before too, and ante is Latin for before

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about whether something comes late and is musically slow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not only after' is read as 'and before'. 'Notedly' means in musical notation, so the definition is a tempo marking.
explanation.definitionFit: In music this tempo marking means at a moderately slow, walking pace.

clue.text: Making an assault-on house modernisation

explanation.definitionFit: Attacking someone is beating them up, and renovating a home is refurbishing it: one phrasal verb covers both.

clue.text: Record a retired medic has to throw out

parts.note: a disc is a gramophone record

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or drawn back, so the word for medic is read backwards

parts.note: Dr is short for doctor, a medic

explanation.surface: A retired doctor has to get rid of an old record.
explanation.definitionFit: To dump or get rid of something is a synonym for throw out.

clue.text: Day when alumni return to southern university

indicators.note: return here means the word for alumni comes back, read backwards

parts.note: BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates or alumni
Bath, in the south-west of England, has a university

explanation.surface: Graduates come back to a university in the south for a holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: The weekly day of rest and worship is a particular day of the week.

clue.text: Make someone enraged

indicators.note: make someone suggests reshaping the following word into a new form

explanation.surface: Drive a person to fury.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: driving someone mad is reworking the letters of 'enraged'.
explanation.definitionFit: To disturb someone's mind or reason, maddening them, is a synonym.

clue.text: Cleaner sea in France. That's wizard

parts.note: a char is a British cleaning woman, a charwoman
mer is French for sea

explanation.surface: A cleaning lady crosses the sea to France and pronounces it great.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wizard' looks like British slang for excellent, but it is the definition: a magician who casts spells.
explanation.definitionFit: A snake handler or enchanter who casts spells is a kind of magician.

clue.text: Happen to fall

explanation.definitionFit: A plan that succeeds takes place as hoped, and a rider tumbling from a horse drops off it: one phrasal verb.

clue.text: Late spring is sunny in London

parts.note: May is the last month of spring
fair weather is sunny

explanation.surface: A weather report: bright days at the end of spring in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: MAYFAIR is a wealthy district of central London.
explanation.definitionFit: The area is a well-known part of the British capital, so it is found there.

clue.text: Eyes symbols of royal power

explanation.definitionFit: Eyeballs are poetically called spheres, and the jewelled globe in regalia is one too.

clue.text: Brief, but most important

explanation.definitionFit: To prepare someone with information is to brief them, and the chief or leading thing is first-rate.

clue.text: Small island returned to you

indicators.note: returned means these words are read backwards from the end

parts.note: ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: A tiny isle is given back to you.
explanation.walkthrough: An eyot (also ait) is a small island in a river, a common British word for those in the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: A river islet is the small piece of land this word names.

clue.text: Right to take a siesta before noon

indicators.note: before puts the first piece ahead of the second

parts.note: to take a siesta is to lie down

explanation.surface: Being entitled to a nap before midday.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal claim to hold another's property until a debt is paid is a kind of entitlement.

clue.text: Present ambassador is full of hesitation

indicators.note: is full of says one piece is filled with the other

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
er is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: An attending diplomat keeps umming and ahhing.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in attendance at a roll call means being at this place.

clue.text: Transport for alien to be arranged

indicators.note: be arranged means the letters of alien to are set in a new order

explanation.surface: Organising a ride for an extraterrestrial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Transport' looks like a vehicle, but it means rapture or great joy.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapture or great joy, as in transports of delight, is a synonym.

clue.text: Herb adds nothing to orange squash

indicators.note: squash suggests the fruit word is crushed and its letters rearranged

parts.note: O is the round figure nought, nothing

explanation.surface: A herb is added to an orange drink with nothing in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Squash' is a British fruit cordial, but here it signals that the letters of 'orange' are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: This aromatic Mediterranean plant, wild marjoram, is a kitchen herb.

clue.text: Conversion following Dr Barnard's ministrations

explanation.walkthrough: Christiaan Barnard performed the first human heart transplant in 1967.
explanation.definitionFit: A reversal of opinion is a conversion, and a transplant gives a patient a new organ literally.
